segments.title: Cold Open & Pre-Stream Technical Check
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on while Case Blackwell troubleshoots microphone fizz and discusses Bachelorette cancellation rumors with off-mic Kendelle.

segments.title: Main News Desk: Middle East Escalation & FEMA Teleportation
segments.notes: Blackwell and Scrum cover US Marine deployment to Middle East, Trump's 200-year lifespan claim, Meta Ray-Ban privacy scandal, and FEMA official Greg Phillips' teleportation claims.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Best Hand Game Debate
segments.notes: Munch advocates for lobster-claw ambidextrous technique while Crum defends both-hands approach; debate devolves into explicit tenderness discourse.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Wall Check-In
segments.notes: Stowaway Peter Gibbon emerges from crawlspace confirming kushball alien and furry raccoon variants now inhabit the wall.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viewer Submissions
segments.notes: Case reviews viewer clips including Cyclopedia reel-to-reel documentary, Palm Beach Pete lookalike, clavicular's halo-effect video, and butthole wellness influencers.

segments.title: CryptoZeu$: Bonk's Revenge Playthrough
segments.notes: Brandon battles through Bonk's Revenge on TurboGrafx-16 while mother Brick interjects through bedroom doggie door; Case Blackwell raids Dr. Diggity-Dank.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored main news desk and Amongst the Web; troubleshot persistent mic fizz; reacted to Trump commemorative coin design.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on and countdown; refused BIN coin placement; confirmed hellcrum poster will never be released.

characters.name: Scrum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Co-hosted news desk; claimed no last name ('Scrum, period'); delivered extended Dragon Ball Z mourning rap during Hype Train trigger.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for lobster-claw masturbation technique in Munch & Crum hand game debate; claimed immortal status.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended both-hands hand game approach; received haircut compliment; threatened drone strike on own debate.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Briefly emerged from wall to confirm multi-variant alien population in crawlspace.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Played Bonk's Revenge on TurboGrafx-16; revealed man-size doggie door in bedroom; sponsored by GamerSlud pineapple cafe.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Triggered by Giggle Trash's 300-bit community sub gift; delivered DBZ freestyle before ejecting.

lore_notes.fact: Scrum asserts mononym identity: 'Scrum, period' with no middle or last name.
FEMA official Greg Phillips claims two teleportation incidents (car lifted 40 miles to ditched church; 50 miles to Waffle House in Rome, Georgia).
US Mint approved 24-karat Trump commemorative gold coin featuring 1776 birth date and idealized jawline.
Brandon installed a man-size doggie door in his bedroom door for cake delivery and crawl-through access.
Brandon secured GamerSlud sponsorship (pineapple cafe flavor with turmeric and methane notes).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered escalating Middle East troop deployments and a FEMA official's teleportation claims before debuting a Trump commemorative coin with a 1776 birth date. The Munch & Crum debate descended into explicit hand-game theory, Peter Gibbon confirmed cryptid expansion in the studio walls, and Brandon fought through Bonk's Revenge while his mother delivered soda through a bedroom doggie door.
